name: Keisen (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Keisen town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Keisen, a town in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1971.

features.role: Keisen town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised letter V
